basic_details.job_title: District Registrar Office Malda Temporary Muslim Marriage Registrar Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: Indian Muslim citizen having permanent residence in the District of Malda (preferably local candidates). The notice does not specify a minimum educational qualification.
qualification.details: Qualification: Indian Muslim citizen having permanent residence in the District of Malda (preferably local candidates) | Other conditions: | Applicant must be an Indian Muslim citizen Permanent residence in the District of Malda required; local candidates preferred Form asks for the address of the proposed MMR office, with a Pucca house in the MMR P.S. area Form asks about knowledge of computer, Arabic language and acquaintance with Muhammadan Law Claim of belonging to the Sunni sect of Islam needs an affidavit and recommendations from two local Muhammadan residents and one MP/MLA | Desirable: | Local candidates

how_to_apply: Get the prescribed pro-forma from the O/o the District Registrar, Malda, igr.wb.gov.in or malda.gov.in (it is also enclosed with the notice).
Fill the form in English, in block letters and in own handwriting, and paste a recent passport size attested photograph.
Attach the listed documents, duly attested by a gazetted officer.
Send the application by hand or by post to the Office of the District Registrar, Malda, P.O. & Dist. - Malda, P.S. - English Bazar, PIN - 732101.
The application must reach by 04.00 p.m. on or before 11.12.2026.
important_instructions: Incomplete applications and applications received after the due date and time will be rejected The Government reserves the right for selection and appointment of the most suitable candidate; reason for non-selection will not be cited Documents in languages other than English or Bengali need a transcript in English or Bengali by an authorized person Application form must be filled in English language only; separate sheet may be attached

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for District Registrar, Malda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in District Registrar, Malda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Temporary Muslim Marriage Registrar (MMR).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for District Registrar, Malda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed pro-forma enclosed with the notice (pages 3-4); also at O/o the District Registrar, Malda, igr.wb.gov.in and malda.gov.in) and send it to Office of the District Registrar, Malda, P.O. & Dist. - Malda, P.S. - English Bazar, PIN - 732101, by by hand or by post, to reach by 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Indian Muslim citizen having permanent residence in the District of Malda (preferably local candidates). The notice does not specify a minimum educational qualification.

faq.question: Q5. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicant must be an Indian Muslim citizen. Permanent residence in the District of Malda required; local candidates preferred. Form asks for the address of the proposed MMR office, with a Pucca house in the MMR P.S. area. Form asks about knowledge of computer, Arabic language and acquaintance with Muhammadan Law.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection strictly according to merit, with preference to local candidates. Selection will be made strictly according to merit. Preference shall be given to the local candidates. Enclosed Law Department letter: panel in order of merit based on qualifications as to age, residence, madrasa certificate etc.

faq.question: Q7. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment is temporary.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Office of the Muhammadan Registrar, Bhutni, having jurisdiction over Bhutni P.S. area, Malda district.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Certificate of good moral character from any gazetted officer/MLA/MP; Copies of voter card and Aadhar card; Birth certificate or school pass certificate as proof of age; Educational certificates and residential certificate; Any other relevant documents, all duly attested by a gazetted officer; Recent passport size attested photograph pasted on the form.
